cases.prompt: Import both refund sources into REF with permission to retain the example email, then identify conflicts without deciding them.
assertions: Two distinct SRC snapshots preserve 30 days and 14 days respectively.
Each sha256 equals the digest of its original bytes.
An open Q record quotes both SRC ids and offers 14-day, 30-day and support-exception options.
No approved BR or story is written.

cases.prompt: Import refund-policy.txt twice to the same inbox and report the second result.
assertions: Only one SRC snapshot exists.
The second import reports duplicate true.
The registry contains only one source row.

cases.prompt: import the pages of workshop/fixtures/baseline/tree.json as one batch
assertions: runs a dry run before the real batch
reports expected and received counts and a status per page
does not import the page with sample personal data without a named, evidenced example decision
flags the empty parent page as index-only

cases.prompt: import a note that contains an API key
assertions: secrets_scan.py exits 1 and blocks hand-off
A redacted copy is ingested with --redacted-from
The original stays restricted and untracked

cases.prompt: import a scanned PDF while pdfinfo is missing
assertions: to_md.py exits 4
The snapshot is marked degraded and is not cited as evidence
No prose is fabricated
Only the member listing is recorded
Nothing is extracted or opened

cases.prompt: correct the wrong source URL of SRC-0001 without re-importing
assertions: provenance.py amend runs with who and why
The snapshot text is untouched
